thread:
alex: billing alert — GPU spend jumped ~3.8x starting ~03:42 UTC, us-west. Noticed this after I woke up, paging now :eyes:
ops-bot: alert: cost_anomaly detected - project=inference-prod region=us-west-2 delta=+280% over 2h (investigate)
alex: looks like a surge of new nodes from the autoscaler. Created ticket INS-4832 and tagging people.
mira: any deploys around 03:30–04:00?
alex: i pushed a small autoscaler tweak at 03:35 — changed the pool selection rule in terraform: `module.autoscaler.node_selector = "${local.env == \"prod\" ? var.prod_selector : var.selector}"` — i think i missed the prod override var.
ram: i pulled the scale events. showing ~620 GPU nodes launched between 03:37–03:49. Most of them are `a100-40gb` family. That's ... expensive.
jen: whoa. we should only be launching T4/P4-ish for batch workloads. Why did it pick A100?
ram: terraform plan shows module `gpu-node-pool` defaulting `instance_family = \"a100\"` when `var.instance_family` undefined. prod tfvars didn't include that variable because of a naming mismatch (`instance_family` vs `gpu_family`). so the module fell back to default.
mira: so a variable naming bug cascaded into spinning up the wrong machine family. :facepalm:
alex: i'm killing scaling and reverting the change now. running: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-gpu-prod --size=60` to cap it, then will drain extra nodes.
jen: also disable autoscaler or set max=100 while we clean up. Add a temporary quota guard.
ram: draining & cordoning nodes: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` bulk script running — will be a few minutes.
ops-bot: action: autoscaler set to manual (max=100) by alex at 03:57 UTC.
alex: rolling rollback commit: `revert: autoscaler selection fix (was missing prod var)` — pushed and `terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars` to correct variable.
mira: good. next steps: 1) confirm all a100 instances terminated 2) open PR to add prod CI check for missing tfvars 3) add guardrail in module to reject unspecified `gpu_family` instead of defaulting to a100.
ram: billing estimate saved: preliminary calc says ~$45k extra across the burst window. I submitted support case to cloud for credits — case #CC-1129.
jen: please paste cloud support case link and mark this as priority. Also schedule a postmortem so we can add a terraform linter rule.
alex: agreed. i'll create the postmortem doc and put a shortblam timeline. Thanks for the quick responses.
billing-bot: note: billing anomaly ticket created: BA-2026 (linked to INS-4832).
ops-bot: reminder - add an explicit `instance_family` check in the module: `if var.instance_family == \"\" { fail(\"instance_family must be set for prod\") }`
mira: i'll own the module change and PR.
alex: closing thread for now — monitoring costs and node counts. if anything spikes again ping me directly. :thumbsup:
